correctness.rationale: PASS: Uniform Haar displacement reduces the intrinsic two-point CDF to area(Voronoi cell intersect radial disk)/A. Radial derivative is r/A times angular survival Theta=2pi minus union of angular forbidden arcs, each new facet yielding half-width arccos(d/r)~sqrt(2eps/d). The perpendicular foot of each genuine planar Voronoi facet is in the facet relative interior, hence its newborn arc is separated from old arcs and other simultaneously born arcs; old endpoints have locally Lipschitz motion, including at vertex meetings. With 2m(d) facets at the common support distance, the two-sided normalized limit is exactly -4m(d)sqrt(2/d), and other radii contribute zero. Four/six genuine facets plus obtuse-superbase geometry yields the constructive lattice recovery; no general higher-dimensional claim. Fresh independent angular-union threshold computation confirmed the square lattice (m=2 at d=1/2) and 1-by-2 rectangle (m=1 at each d=1/2,1), with 1e-8 radius offsets. These numerical checks do not prove all-lattice result.
